# The Raye application categories (Start, menu editor, app pickers).
# raye-applications.menu is generated by gen-menu.py and committed.

install(FILES raye-applications.menu DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSCONFDIR}/xdg/menus)
install(FILES raye-menu.sh DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSCONFDIR}/xdg/plasma-workspace/env)

file(GLOB _raye_menu_directories CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/desktop-directories/raye-*.directory)
install(FILES ${_raye_menu_directories} DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_DESKTOPDIR})

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
# started by the quick link menu of Start; not a menu entry of its own
install(FILES org.raye.terminal-admin.desktop DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_APPDIR})
